summary.text: Joe Cohenour is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 83, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Aaron Leas in a race with no incumbent.
Ballotpedia lists him as a previous Democratic candidate for the Montana House in 2010 and 2012.

paragraphs.text: Joe Cohenour appears on Ballotpedia as a Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 78 in 2012, when he ran unopposed in the June 5 primary and lost the general election to incumbent Republican Steve Gibson, 52.2 percent to 47.8 percent.
Ballotpedia also records that Cohenour won a 2010 Democratic primary over Molly Severtson, 456 votes to 342, and then faced Gibson in the November 2, 2010 general election.
